LanguageData.MI_RespiratoryFailure.label: respiratory failure
LanguageData.MI_RespiratoryFailure.description: Breathing has stopped. Restore the airway or functioning lungs immediately. The respiratory failure timer reaches fatal severity in approximately three game hours. Without restored oxygen delivery, unprotected cerebral hypoxia can become fatal in about 1.5 game hours and often limits the rescue window first.
LanguageData.MI_RespiratoryFailure.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_RespiratoryFailure.stages.2.label: near death
LanguageData.MI_LiverFailure.label: acute liver failure
LanguageData.MI_LiverFailure.description: No functioning liver tissue remains. A functioning replacement can resolve this failure. Without it, failure progresses toward death over approximately one game day.
LanguageData.MI_LiverFailure.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_LiverFailure.stages.2.label: near death
LanguageData.MI_RenalFailure.label: acute renal failure
LanguageData.MI_RenalFailure.description: No functioning kidney tissue remains. One functioning kidney or a suitable replacement can resolve this failure. Untreated complete failure becomes fatal over approximately five game days.
LanguageData.MI_RenalFailure.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_RenalFailure.stages.2.label: near death
LanguageData.MI_FiltrationFailure.label: blood filtration failure
LanguageData.MI_FiltrationFailure.description: Blood filtration has stopped without an identified complete liver or kidney failure. Restore the underlying filtration capacity. Untreated failure becomes fatal over approximately one game day.
LanguageData.MI_FiltrationFailure.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_FiltrationFailure.stages.2.label: near death
LanguageData.MI_MetabolicFailure.label: metabolic failure
LanguageData.MI_MetabolicFailure.description: Metabolism has stopped. Restore the affected organs or capacity. Untreated failure becomes fatal over approximately three game days.
LanguageData.MI_MetabolicFailure.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_MetabolicFailure.stages.2.label: near death
LanguageData.MI_Coma.label: coma
LanguageData.MI_Coma.description: Consciousness has fallen to zero, although the brain is structurally present. Treat the cause. This condition resolves when consciousness returns; persistent untreated coma becomes fatal over approximately five game days. Coma alone does not imply oxygen deprivation.
LanguageData.MI_Coma.stages.1.label: severe
LanguageData.MI_Coma.stages.2.label: near death
